coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Pier 70 Parcel C1
record.summary: Block between 21st Street, Louisiana Street and the Irish Hill remnant, 90 ft under the D4D and permitted as residential, commercial or a district parking garage. It is subdivided in the SUD land-use plan into C1A (a Port-controlled parcel once designated for a parking structure), C1B (a 100%-affordable housing site, listed in Phase 3 of the Port's 2026 report) and C1C.

notes.accuracy_caveat: The outline is the union of Assessor lots 4112001, 4112002 and 4112003, so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a trace. That this is the lot of Parcel C1 is Pier & Point's own inference from location, shape and size (our earlier trace of the D4D figure measured 4,803 m2 against the lot's 4,721 m2; 86% of the trace lies inside the lot and the trace covers 88% of it). No Port document read ties the lot number to it. A building may sit back from the lot lines. No vertical construction is reported on this block (Port Item 11A, Aug 7, 2026, says construction of Phase 1 vertical projects and parks has not moved forward; it draws this block in Phase 2B of its proposed phasing plan, outside Phase 1, and does not mention construction on it).
notes.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 4112001, 4112002 and 4112003 (recorded 2019-02-07; mapped 2019-03-14; active), joined into one outline; cross-checked against Pier 70 Design for Development Figure 6.4.2 - Building Height Maximum (p.155).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: No single Assessor lot is documented as Parcel C1. Lots 4112001, 4112002 and 4112003 (active) match its location, shape and size, so its outline is the union of Assessor lots 4112001, 4112002 and 4112003; the identification is Pier & Point's inference, as the accuracy note says.
notes.regulatory_context: Flexible use: the D4D's Figure 2.1.1 stripes C1 Commercial-Office, Residential and Parking Garage, and its land-use scenarios show a garage or partial garage, 'permitted to be residential or commercial based on future parking needs' (use set to 'mixed' on the map); 90 ft max per Figure 6.4.2 (a uniform height, not a 65-90 ft range). C1B (a sub-portion of this parcel) is a 100%-affordable housing parcel: Port Resolution 20-07 (Item 12B, Feb 2020) names 'the 100% affordable housing parcels (Parcels C1B and C2A)', and Port Item 11A (Aug 2026, p.3) lists three designated affordable parcels, C2A (Phase 1), Parcel K South (Phase 2) and C1B (Phase 3); the same memo's proposed phasing plan (Exhibit A, p.8) draws the C1 block as Phase 2B, and the memo does not reconcile the two. No construction-start source found.

open_questions: No construction start, building permit or vertical DDA for this parcel was found in any Port Commission document through the Port's Item 11A staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026, for the Aug 11, 2026 meeting), which says the developer 'has not exercised an option of any Phase 1 option parcels'.

Per-parcel gross square footage and unit counts are not published in the D4D (which sets height, stories and land-use scenarios, not parcel programs); the SUD's per-parcel programs would be in the SUD ordinance (Planning Code Sec. 249.79) or the Phase Submittal, neither of which was retrieved.

No developer, unit count or funding plan for the C1B affordable site was found; the August 2026 Port report says the affordable gap-funding sources (condo in-lieu fee, commercial impact fee, Hoedown Yard IRFD increment) 'are currently unavailable as market-rate development has yet to occur'.
The boundaries of C1A/C1B/C1C within this block are only shown diagrammatically on the SUD land-use plan; this record's geometry covers the whole C1 block.
